rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for weekdays in contrast with weekends.

example.english: The MTR is less crowded on a weekday; weekends are different.
example.traditional: 平日搭地鐵冇咁逼，周末就唔同。
example.jyutping: ping4 jat6 daap3 dei6 tit3 mou5 gam3 bik1 zau1 mut6 zau6 m4 tung4

rows.note: Use this when you want to state explicitly that you mean Monday through Friday.

example.english: I have to work every weekday, Monday through Friday.
example.jyutping: sing1 kei4 jat1 zi3 ng5 dou1 jiu3 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this when the focus is on workdays, especially in schedules or workplace contexts.

example.english: The application will be processed on the next weekday.
example.traditional: 申請會喺下一個工作日處理。
example.jyutping: san1 cing2 wui5 hai2 haa6 jat1 go3 gung1 zok3 jat6 cyu2 lei5
